reason: bytesAlias (propagation.go:53-60) bounds result end by len(input) instead of cap(input), so ByteWindow drops valid beyond-length/within-capacity 2- and 3-index reslices. Independently reproduced through the internal API (Go 1.26.6 and 1.27.0) and through a woven io.ReadAll body source with a customer lexer growing a token (tok=tok[:len(tok)+1]): bytes, assigned string conversion, and SQL-style query are all untainted, while the in-length control stays tainted. The feature is advertised as supported in README:33/44-45, so this violates product rule 4. A one-line cap-bound fix restores exact ranges, and the existing suites stay green.
